entries.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed Mayhem in the Market (accepting the reward is not required) or any foreign characters, the gate from The Undercity into Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) will be closed, and if the party contains any foreign characters that have not completed Welcome to Cantha (accepting the reward is not required) or any Factions characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter, the gate from Bukdek Byway into Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) will be closed.
entries.text: 開始此主線任務本身沒有前置要求，但進入兩個據點的大門各有條件：若隊伍中有任何尚未完成 Mayhem in the Market（不必領取獎勵）的《盟與敵》角色，或任何外地角色，從地下城通往薇茹廣場（本地區域）的大門便會關閉。若隊伍中有任何尚未完成「歡迎來到凱珊」（不必領取獎勵）的外地角色，或任何尚未完成「納普區」的《盟與敵》角色，從巴德克小徑通往薇茹廣場（外地區域）的大門便會關閉。
entries.reason: 分開兩扇門的關閉條件；保留任一隊員、角色出身與不必領獎三項限制。未證中文的任務名保留英文。

entries.source: Mayhem in the Market grants access to the Local Quarter, but any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun will be left behind in The Undercity.
entries.text: 完成 Mayhem in the Market 可進入本地區域，但任何尚未完成「禎台郡」的角色都會被留在地下城。
entries.reason: 區分任務開門與禎台郡完成資格；採固定中文模板的本地區域名稱。

entries.source: Welcome to Cantha grants access to the Foreign Quarter.
entries.text: 完成「歡迎來到凱珊」可進入外地區域。
entries.reason: grants access 表示開放通行，Foreign Quarter 採中文模板的外地區域。

entries.source:
Locate the source of the plague in Kaineng City.
 Find Togo in Vizunah Square. (If your party is from Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter).)
 Hold out until Mhenlo 's party arrives. (If your party is from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter).)
 Travel with Mhenlo and Togo in search of the plague's source.
 Defeat Shiro's Construct.
entries.text:
找出凱寧城的瘟疫源頭。
 找到薇茹廣場中的藤吾。（從薇茹廣場（外地區域）出發的隊伍。）
 堅守到涵洛的隊伍抵達。（從薇茹廣場（本地區域）出發的隊伍。）
 與涵洛及藤吾同行，尋找瘟疫源頭。
 擊敗 Shiro's Construct。
entries.reason: Togo 是藤吾而非多哥；保留本地與外地目標分支，未證構裝體中文名保留英文身份。

entries.source: Mhenlo must survive.
entries.text: 涵洛必須存活。
entries.reason: must survive 為必須存活的任務失敗條件，涵洛名稱有中文模板佐證。

entries.source: Togo must survive.
entries.text: 藤吾必須存活。
entries.reason: 修正 Togo 為藤吾；保留必須存活的條件。

entries.source: The local and foreign parties start at separate locations. The local party, together with Master Togo, will enter an area where they will be faced with spawning Afflicted. The foreign party, with Mhenlo, will need to fight several groups of Am Fah enemies first to make their way to the meet up point. Since Master Togo has to be kept alive, a common reason to fail the mission is for the local party to become overwhelmed and Togo dies, before the foreign party arrives. To prevent this, the local party should place more emphasis on healing compared to the foreign one. Once the two groups meet, healers from both parties are able to heal both NPCs.
entries.text: 本地與外地隊伍從不同地點出發。本地隊伍與藤吾大師同行，進入一處會不斷出現受感染者（Afflicted）的區域。外地隊伍則與涵洛同行，必須先擊敗幾群安費敵人，才能抵達會合處。藤吾大師必須存活，因此常見的失敗原因是：外地隊伍尚未抵達，本地隊伍便已不敵攻勢，導致藤吾死亡。為避免此情況，本地隊伍應比外地隊伍更重視治療。兩隊會合後，雙方的治療者都能治療這兩名 NPC。
entries.reason: party 是隊伍，spawn 是出現而非產卵；修正藤吾名稱與本地隊伍優先治療的因果。

entries.source: After the first large battle, the mission follows a linear path, including two other large fights at Afflicted spawning points. During these fights, multiple waves of Afflicted spawn (and respawn) from three separate points. The Afflicted Soul Explosion can overwhelm parties in these situations. Eliminating the afflicted bosses will stop the respawning of Afflicted and cause the opening of the nearby gate, allowing continuation of the mission. Spread apart and try to intercept the spawns with three "mini-parties" instead of fighting them all in one big melee.
entries.text: 第一場大型戰鬥結束後，任務沿單一路線推進，途中還有兩場發生在受感染者（Afflicted）出現地點的大型戰鬥。這些戰鬥中，多波受感染者會從三個不同位置出現並重生；此時 Afflicted Soul Explosion 可能使隊伍不堪負荷。消滅受感染者頭目後，受感染者便不再重生，附近的大門也會開啟，讓任務繼續。分散隊伍，以三支「小隊」分別攔截各處出現的敵人，避免集中在一起混戰。
entries.reason: 區分三處出怪點與三個小隊；頭目死亡才停止重生並開門。未證技能中文名保留英文。

entries.source: Note that while you can heal members of the other group, you cannot resurrect them. Each party has to provide for their own means of resurrection.
entries.text: 雖然可以治療另一支隊伍的成員，卻無法復活他們；每支隊伍都必須自行準備復活手段。
entries.reason: 保留跨隊可治療但不能復活的機制差異。

entries.source: This mission has numerous bugs, some forcing a restart. See the notes for details.
entries.text: 此主線任務有多種程式錯誤，其中一些會迫使玩家重新開始任務。詳情見注意事項。
entries.reason: restart 指重新開始任務，不是重啟遊戲或程式。

entries.source: Bring skills that can affect multiple allies, since there will be 16 characters (from the two parties) plus Togo and Mhenlo.
entries.text: 攜帶能影響多名盟友的技能，因為場上有兩隊合計 16 名角色，另外還有藤吾與涵洛。
entries.reason: 明確 16 為兩隊角色總數，兩名 NPC 另計。

entries.source: Area of effect skills are very helpful because the fighting is tight and packed. Wards, wells, and point blank area of effect skills are very effective in this mission. Area of effect skills that inflict damage can cause many Afflicted Soul Explosions to trigger at the same time.
entries.text: 戰鬥範圍狹窄、敵我密集，因此範圍技能非常有用。結界類技能、池類技能，以及以自身為中心的範圍技能，在此任務中特別有效。造成傷害的範圍技能也可能同時觸發多次 Afflicted Soul Explosion。
entries.reason: wards 和 wells 對應結界及池類技能，point blank AoE 是以自身為中心，非守衛或水井。

entries.source: There are enough exploitable corpses to support several minion masters; however, remember that the sacrifice from Blood of the Master is determined by the total number of allied minions.
entries.text: 可利用的屍體足以供多名召喚不死僕從的角色使用。不過，「主人之血」所需犧牲的體力，取決於所有友方不死僕從的總數。
entries.reason: minion masters 是召喚不死僕從的角色；犧牲量以友方僕從總數計算，而非僅自己的僕從。

entries.source: "I Will Avenge You!" will benefit from the deaths of Canthan Guards and Peasants; it can provide a near-continuous buff during the mission.
entries.text: 「我要報仇!」會因凱珊衛兵與農民死亡而受益，能在此任務中提供幾乎不間斷的增益。
entries.reason: 採中文技能模板的「我要報仇!」，保留 NPC 死亡可觸發與近乎持續兩項語義。

entries.source: Speed boosts (e.g. "Fall Back!") are helpful for two reasons: the mission is timed and often party members will find themselves running from one fight to another.
entries.text: 移動加速技能（例如「回防！」）有兩個用途：此任務按完成時間計算成績，而且隊員常需從一處戰場跑向另一處。
entries.reason: Fall Back! 採中文模板「回防！」；timed 指計算完成時間，不是固定時間自動開始。

entries.source: Afflicted Ritualists can slow progress, especially in hard mode since they are potent healers who can resurrect their allies. Bring shutdowns or other anti-caster skills.
entries.text: 受感染者祭祀者能強力治療並復活盟友，會拖慢推進速度，困難模式下尤其如此。攜帶能封鎖其行動的技能，或其他壓制施法者的技能。
entries.reason: Ritualists 是祭祀者；shutdowns 是技能封鎖或壓制，不是關機。

entries.source: If entering from Local Quarter, consider not bringing Signet of Spirits, since Chiyo of the Foreign Quarter party (if no player-Foreign Quarter party joins) uses it.
entries.text: 若從本地區域進入，可考慮不帶「縛靈紋章」：沒有玩家組成的外地隊伍加入時，外地隊伍的 Chiyo 會使用此技能。
entries.reason: 保留沒有玩家外地隊伍加入的限定；不將 NPC 英文名猜譯成未證正式名稱。

entries.source: Enchantment-based builds are vulnerable to enchantment removal by Afflicted Necromancers and Mesmers. Afflicted that deal physical damage can also remove enchantments when enchanted with Afflicted Necromancer's Order of Apostasy.
entries.text: 依賴加持的技能配置容易受到受感染者死靈法師及幻術師的移除加持技能克制。造成物理傷害的受感染者若受到死靈法師「背叛命令」的加持，也能移除加持。
entries.reason: Mesmers 是幻術師，build 是技能配置；後句主詞為造成物理傷害且受背叛命令加持的敵人。

entries.source: When a boss is killed, the subsequent Morale Boost is only awarded to the party that inflicted the killing blow.
entries.text: 擊殺頭目後，只有造成最後一擊的那支隊伍會獲得隨後的士氣提升。
entries.reason: Morale Boost 是士氣提升；保留只授予完成擊殺的隊伍，移除計程車誤轉。

entries.source: You will have to fight some of the Canthan civilians, who have been infected by the plague. On dying, they will spawn an Afflicted creature; such spawned Afflicted, while technically hostile to the party, will not attack you and will generally try to flee. However, you'll usually end up killing them anyway as any NPCs in your party will attack them.
entries.text: 你必須與一些染上瘟疫的凱珊平民戰鬥。他們死亡時會出現一隻受感染者（Afflicted）；這些受感染者雖被判定為敵對，卻不會攻擊玩家，通常還會試圖逃跑。不過，隊伍中的 NPC 會攻擊牠們，因此往往仍會將牠們擊殺。
entries.reason: 區分平民死亡後出現敵人與該敵人不主動攻擊的行為；保留 NPC 會攻擊的因果。

entries.source: The death that occurs during the end cinematic does not halt progress of the Survivor title track.
entries.text: 結尾動畫中發生的死亡，不會中斷「生存者」稱號的進度。
entries.reason: title track 是稱號進度，不是主打歌；保留動畫死亡的例外。

entries.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #1 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
entries.text: 完成此主線任務會填入故事書 Shiro's Return 的第 #1 頁。
entries.reason: 保留故事書英文身份與頁碼，不將所有格 Shiro's 拼接到未證中文書名。

entries.source: On completion of this mission, your party will appear in Dragon's Throat.
entries.text: 完成此主線任務後，隊伍會出現在龍喉。
entries.reason: appear 指完成後抵達地點；原文僅為據點名稱，不添加挑戰任務限制。

entries.source: A large chunk of the inaccessible southeast corner can be explored for Canthan Cartographer by viewing the mission cinematic. (Talk to Guardsman Chow in the Foreign Quarter to replay it.)
entries.text: 觀看此主線任務的動畫，可探索平時無法進入的東南角大片區域，增加凱珊製圖稱號的探索進度。（與外地區域的 Guardsman Chow 交談可重播動畫。）
entries.reason: Cartographer 是探索製圖稱號，非版圖地區；守衛姓名保留英文而非把 Chow 當星期週。

entries.source: It is possible for Togo to die before you reach him the first time, thus failing the mission.
entries.text: 第一次抵達藤吾身邊前，他就可能已經死亡，導致主線任務失敗。
entries.reason: 修正 Togo 名稱並保留抵達前已可發生失敗的時序。

entries.source: The Foreign Quarter party need only defeat the first four Am Fah at the start of the mission, and then simply wait and leave Mhenlo to run his scripted path to reach Master Togo alone. All of the other foes on the route are popups and are not triggered by Mhenlo. When he walks to the bottom, the cinematic teleports the Foreign Quarter party down into the square.
entries.text: 外地隊伍只需在任務開始時擊敗最先遇到的四名安費敵人，之後便可原地等待，讓涵洛獨自沿預設路線前往藤吾大師處。路上其他敵人都是接近後才會出現的伏兵，涵洛不會觸發牠們。涵洛走到底部時，過場動畫會將外地隊伍傳送到廣場。
entries.reason: popups 是接近時出現的伏兵，不是彈出視窗；leave Mhenlo 指讓涵洛獨自行動，非離開他。

entries.source: Some Afflicted may spawn without weapons.
entries.text: 部分受感染者（Afflicted）出現時可能沒有武器。
entries.reason: spawn 在此指敵人出現，保留可能無武器的觀察。

entries.source: This mission highlights many deficiencies in the NPC pathfinding AI:
entries.text: 此主線任務暴露了 NPC 尋路 AI 的多項缺陷：
entries.reason: 現譯尋路機制方向正確，保留引出後續缺陷清單的冒號。

entries.source: It is possible for a henchman-only party to get stuck behind a chest, forcing you to either restart the mission or continue alone. If the henchman party is starting from the Foreign Quarter, this can happen before they reach the first meeting point. It is possible for Togo or Mhenlo to get stuck in the same way.
entries.text: 全由傭兵組成的隊伍可能卡在寶箱後方，迫使玩家重新開始任務或獨自繼續。若傭兵隊伍從外地區域出發，可能尚未抵達第一個會合處便已卡住。藤吾或涵洛也可能以同樣方式卡住。
entries.reason: henchman 是傭兵，非玩家追隨者；保留會合前卡住及兩名 NPC 同樣受影響的範圍。

entries.source: It is possible for Togo to just get stuck for no reason, which causes the last fight to fail to initialize, making the final battle of the mission impossible to complete.
entries.text: 藤吾可能無故卡住，使最後一場戰鬥無法觸發，因而無法完成此主線任務。
entries.reason: initialize 指觸發最後戰鬥，非需要玩家初始化；修正藤吾專名。

entries.source: If you bring minions, Mhenlo can get distracted in healing them, causing him not to reach his waypoints. A sign that this has happened is Togo standing still some distance behind the party. If this happens, try moving back towards Togo; when Mhenlo gets close enough, the missed waypoint will trigger and Togo will start moving again.
entries.text: 若帶著不死僕從，涵洛可能忙於治療牠們，因而未抵達預定路徑點。此時常見的跡象是藤吾停在隊伍後方一段距離。可嘗試往藤吾所在處退回；當涵洛靠得夠近，先前未觸發的路徑點就會觸發，藤吾也會繼續前進。
entries.reason: 區分涵洛漏過路徑點與藤吾停步；保留返回讓涵洛接近才恢復的操作。

entries.source: If your party has a monk maintaining Unyielding Aura, Shiro won't wipe the whole party. If the party leader is resurrected by this means, they will not appear in the proper place for the cinematics.
entries.text: 若隊伍中的僧侶正在維持「堅毅靈氣」，白影便不會使整支隊伍全滅。若隊長藉此復活，便不會出現在過場動畫所需的正確位置。
entries.reason: monk 是僧侶而非武士，party leader 是隊長而非黨魁；白影由固定中文模板佐證。

entries.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed Mayhem in the Market (accepting the reward is not required) or any foreign characters, the gate from The Undercity into Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) will be closed, and if the party contains any foreign characters that have not completed Welcome to Cantha (accepting the reward is not required) or any Factions characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter, the gate from Bukdek Byway into Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) will be closed.
Mayhem in the Market grants access to the Local Quarter, but any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun will be left behind in The Undercity.
Welcome to Cantha grants access to the Foreign Quarter.
entries.text:
開始此主線任務本身沒有前置要求，但進入兩個據點的大門各有條件：若隊伍中有任何尚未完成 Mayhem in the Market（不必領取獎勵）的《盟與敵》角色，或任何外地角色，從地下城通往薇茹廣場（本地區域）的大門便會關閉。若隊伍中有任何尚未完成「歡迎來到凱珊」（不必領取獎勵）的外地角色，或任何尚未完成「納普區」的《盟與敵》角色，從巴德克小徑通往薇茹廣場（外地區域）的大門便會關閉。
完成 Mayhem in the Market 可進入本地區域，但任何尚未完成「禎台郡」的角色都會被留在地下城。
完成「歡迎來到凱珊」可進入外地區域。
entries.reason: 同步完整條件摘要與三段已審原文；保留兩扇門、角色出身、任務完成及領獎差異。

entries.source: Tyrian (Prophecies) or Canthan (Factions) character
entries.text: 在《阿斯卡隆戰記》或《盟與敵》中建立的角色。
entries.reason: character 指角色；Tyrian、Canthan 在此限定角色建立篇章，而非文字編碼。

entries.source: Tyrian (Prophecies) or Elonian (Nightfall) character
entries.text: 在《阿斯卡隆戰記》或《黑暗逆襲》中建立的角色。
entries.reason: 角色出身限定為兩個篇章，修正字元並明確章節身份。

entries.source: Koss must be present in the party.
entries.text: 寇斯必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: party 指遊戲隊伍，必須帶寇斯而非出席聚會。

entries.source: Having M.O.X. in the party. (Doesn't have to be in the party during the three quests.)
entries.text: M.O.X. 必須在隊伍中。（進行那三個任務期間，不必一直把他帶在隊伍中。）
entries.reason: 首句的接取要求與括號中的任務進行階段不同，不將不必在隊伍誤作完全無需英雄。

entries.source: Melonni must be present in the party.
entries.text: 梅隆妮必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留指定英雄必須入隊的限制，修正聚會。

entries.source: You should increase your party size. Go through the outpost out into the Issnur Isles, kill the 4 groups of undead as indicated on the map to the right. Then head to the Mehtani Keys, where 3 more groups of undead await.
entries.text: 建議擴充隊伍人數。穿過據點前往伊斯諾島，消滅右圖標示的 4 群不死族，再前往梅坦尼之鑰，那裡還有 3 群不死族。
entries.reason: 4 與 3 均為敵人群數，舊稿遺漏群單位並顛倒語序；party size 是隊伍人數。

entries.source: Tahlkora must be present in the party.
entries.text: 塔爾科拉必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留指定英雄入隊條件，非必須出席聚會。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Regent Valley and start the mission. Completing The Great Northern Wall also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從統治者之谷步行進入此據點，開始主線任務。完成「北方長城」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: walk into 指步行入據點；完成前一主線的傳送對象是隊伍。

entries.source: The party size is only 4 so:
entries.text: 隊伍人數上限只有 4 人，因此：
entries.reason: party size 在攻略語境為隊伍人數上限，不是聚會規模；保留 4。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Diessa Lowlands and start the mission. Completing Ruins of Surmia also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從底耶沙低地步行進入此據點，開始主線任務。完成「蘇米亞廢墟」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: 保留可直接步行或完成前一主線兩條抵達途徑；party 是隊伍。

entries.source: The party size is only four:
entries.text: 隊伍人數上限只有四人：
entries.reason: four 保留原文字數字；語境為四人隊伍限制。

entries.source: Bring party heals.
entries.text: 攜帶能治療整支隊伍的技能。
entries.reason: party heals 指全隊治療技能，不是聚會療癒活動。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Anvil Rock and start the mission. Completing Borlis Pass also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從鐵砧石步行進入此據點，開始主線任務。完成「柏里斯通道」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: 修正 party 語義並保留步行入場不受前一主線完成與否限制。

entries.source: Gain the rank of Sunspear Captain or Level 17. (For Nightfall characters only.)
entries.text: 取得烈陽之矛隊長階級，或達到等級 17。（僅限《黑暗逆襲》建立的角色。）
entries.reason: rank 和 level 是替代條件，保留或；character 是該篇章建立的角色。

entries.source: Foreign characters
entries.text: 外地角色
entries.reason: Foreign characters 在跨篇章旅行攻略中指非當地篇章角色，非外文字元。

entries.source: Dunkoro must be present in the party.
entries.text: Dunkoro 必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 修正指定英雄必須入隊的語義；中文定名無直接佐證時保留英文。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Watchtower Coast and start the mission. Completing D'Alessio Seaboard also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從瞭望塔海岸步行進入此據點，開始主線任務。完成「達雷西海濱」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: 區分抵達途徑與前置要求，修正聚會為隊伍。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Silverwood and start the mission. Completing The Wilds also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從銀樹步行進入此據點，開始主線任務。完成「荒原」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: 保留任意角色可步行與完成前一主線自動抵達兩種方式。

entries.source: Keep the party spread out; the enemies have lots of dangerous AoE skills.
entries.text: 隊員保持分散；敵人有許多危險的範圍技能。
entries.reason: spread out 要求隊員拉開站位，party 不是聚會。

entries.source: Be careful at the main gate to Shaemoor; it is possible to aggro several small groups from inside the town creating a 20-foe mob. Should this happen (often after a party wipe), it can appear to be difficult to pull the groups apart. Take advantage of the gate as a natural choke point for blocking and using AoE skills.
entries.text: 在夏恩摩正門附近要小心：可能同時引到鎮內幾小群敵人，形成一支 20 名敵人的大群。這種情況常發生在隊伍全滅之後，屆時可能很難把各群敵人分開。可利用大門這個天然狹口卡位，並施放範圍技能。
entries.reason: aggro 是引敵，party wipe 是全隊死亡而非聚會結束；保留 20 名敵人與狹口卡位建議。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Stingray Strand and start the mission. Completing Riverside Province also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從魟魚湖濱步行進入此據點，開始主線任務。完成「河畔地帶」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: 傳送到據點的對象是隊伍，步行入場途徑保持。

entries.source: Margrid the Sly must be present in the party.
entries.text: 狡猾的瑪格麗德必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 指定英雄必須入隊，不是出席聚會。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Prophet's Path or Skyward Reach and talk to Great Ritual Priest Zahmut to start the mission. Completing Dunes of Despair, Thirsty River, or Elona Reach also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從先知之路或天際流域步行進入此據點，與儀式大祭司撒穆特交談，開始主線任務。完成「絕望沙丘」、「乾枯河流」或「伊洛那流域」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: 保留入場交談對象、兩條步行途徑及三個可傳送至此的前一主線；未將或改成且。

entries.source: Master of Whispers must be present in the party.
entries.text: 密語大師必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: must be present 指英雄需實際入隊，非參加聚會。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Frozen Forest and start the mission. Completing Ice Caves of Sorrow also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從冰凍森林步行進入此據點，開始主線任務。完成「悲傷冰谷」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: 修正隊伍傳送語義，保留前一主線不是步行入場必要條件。

entries.source: Death during this mission will cause a note to come up saying "MISSION FAILED: You died during the party. Drink responsibly next time!"
entries.text: 在此任務期間死亡將導致出現一條提示，上面寫著“任務失敗：你在聚會期間死亡。下次請負責任地飲酒！”
entries.reason: 本段描述飲酒宴會任務的失敗訊息，party 確實是聚會，現譯正確，不能全域替換為隊伍。

entries.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Ice Floe and start the mission. Completing Iron Mines of Moladune also brings the party here.
entries.text: 任何角色都能從浮冰步行進入此據點，開始主線任務。完成「莫拉登礦山」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
entries.reason: party 是隊伍，保留步行與完成前一主線兩種抵達途徑。

entries.source: Ensure you have a balanced party.
entries.text: 確保隊伍配置均衡。
entries.reason: balanced party 指職能或技能配置均衡的隊伍，非平衡的聚會。

entries.source: Quest markers do not display the peasants' locations. The final dialogue "our work here is done" can be shown and the quest can still fail. This happens when you lure Afflicted far away from the last peasant and kill this group of Afflicted when the peasant is outside the party area.
entries.text: 任務標記不會顯示農民的位置。即使出現最後一句對話「我們在這裡的工作完成了」，任務仍可能失敗：若把受感染者（Afflicted）引到遠離最後一名農民的位置，並在該農民已位於隊伍範圍之外時擊殺那群敵人，就會發生這種情況。
entries.reason: 保留對話不保證成功與農民在隊伍範圍外時擊殺的同時條件；party area 是隊伍範圍。

entries.source: General Morgahn must be present in the party.
entries.text: 摩根將軍必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留指定英雄必須入隊的條件，修正聚會。

entries.source: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support will trigger them well away from the party.
entries.text: 使用 Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support，可在遠離隊伍的位置觸發牠們出現。
entries.reason: 觸發的是遠處敵人，並非使敵人遠離隊伍；未證技能中文名稱保留英文。

entries.source: Most groups encounter some difficulty defeating one or both of these foes. The most important step is to pull them apart and it is almost always easier to have Shiro chase you. Set up your party just outside of the temple gate; if you have them, you can use spirits and/or minions and/or tanks to block each boss from reaching your backline.
entries.text: 多數隊伍要擊敗這兩名敵人中的一名或兩名，都會遇到困難。最重要的是把他們分開，而讓白影追著你跑通常較容易。把隊伍部署在神殿大門外；若有適合的角色或技能，可用精魂、不死僕從或承受攻擊的前排角色卡位，阻止兩名頭目接近後排。
entries.reason: Shiro 為白影，spirits/minions/tanks 是精魂、僕從及前排承傷角色；boss 不是老闆，set up party 不是舉辦聚會。

entries.source: Blind is great when bringing spellcaster-heavy parties, e.g. from Blinding Flash, Eruption, Ebon Dust Aura, Shadowsong, or Sneak Attack.
entries.text: 隊伍若以施法者為主，致盲效果會很有幫助，例如「眩目之光」、「火山爆發」、「烏塵靈氣」、「闇影共鳴」或 Sneak Attack 所造成的致盲。
entries.reason: Blind 是致盲病症而非盲人；保留施法者較多時的建議與技能例子。

entries.source: Start from Ran Musu Gardens and head southwest to the Tengu camp. The initial group of Ministry troops will be reinforced by two groups, one from the west and another from the south. Since your party is small:
entries.text: 從嵐穆蘇花園出發，往西南走到天狗營地。最初的 Ministry 部隊會獲得兩批增援，一批來自西方，另一批來自南方。由於隊伍人數較少：
entries.reason: 補回被舊譯遺漏的 Ministry 部隊身份，保留兩批增援與兩個方向；party 指隊伍。

entries.source: This quest should actually be quite easy. The map to the upper right shows the path you will take. Normally you only encounter 3 groups of 3-4 afflicted (level 12-15) each. Because you are helped by Su, Professor Gai, Sister Tai, and Kai Ying, killing these afflicted should not be a problem. For this reason, you should consider doing any of the area's secondary quests before completing this quest; they will also be much easier due to your larger party. Be cautious though, as Su must be alive when you finally reach Master Togo, or you will not be allowed into the next outpost (if there's a problem, Su is often the first of the four to die).
entries.text: 這個任務應該相當容易，右上方地圖標示了行進路線。通常只會遇到 3 群受感染者（Afflicted），每群 3-4 名，等級為 12-15。由於有 Su、Professor Gai、Sister Tai 和 Kai Ying 協助，擊敗牠們應不成問題。因此，可考慮先完成此區域的其他支線任務，再完成本任務；有較大的隊伍同行，這些任務也會容易許多。但抵達藤吾大師身邊時，Su 必須仍然存活，否則將無法進入下一個據點。（一旦出事，Su 往往是這四人中最先死亡的。）
entries.reason: 修復 3 群、每群 3-4 名及等級 12-15 的數量層次，保留 Su 存活才能進據點的限制；無確證 NPC 譯名保留英文。

entries.source: To Tahnnakai Temple grants access, but any characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter will be left behind in Shenzun Tunnels.
entries.text: 完成「前往譚納凱神殿」可開放通行，但任何尚未完成「納普區」的角色都會被留在申贊通道。
entries.reason: character 是角色；區分開門任務與可隨隊通過的主線完成條件。

entries.source: You can farm insects in Fahranur, The First City. Start from Blacktide Den if you want a party of eight.
entries.text: 可在舊城法蘭努爾反覆擊殺昆蟲刷取物品。若想組成八人隊伍，請從黑潮之穴出發。
entries.reason: farm 指反覆刷怪而非養殖；Blacktide Den 有中文模板佐證，八人隊伍保留文字數字。

entries.source: It may be difficult to complete this quest if you are using a free trial account, as you can't use chat or invite another player to your party. It would require being invited to a party, or obtaining Devona.
entries.text: 使用免費試玩帳號時，此任務可能較難完成，因為無法使用聊天功能，也不能邀請其他玩家入隊。你需要由別人邀請加入隊伍，或招募德佛娜。
entries.reason: 被邀請的是遊戲隊伍，不是聚會；保留試玩帳號限制及兩種替代做法。

entries.source: Clear the spiders out from around the Spider Eggs. It is useful to the party if you light the eggs one at a time to prevent the party being overwhelmed by the popups. Also on the fourth group of eggs, the spawn of spiders is delayed. After lighting all the eggs, a Spider Matriarch will appear.
entries.text: 清除蜘蛛卵周圍的蜘蛛。每次只點燃一顆卵，有助於避免隊伍被突然出現的敵人壓倒。第四組卵的蜘蛛會延遲出現。點燃全部蜘蛛卵後，會出現一隻 Spider Matriarch。
entries.reason: eggs 是蜘蛛卵而非雞蛋或彩蛋，popups 是突然出現的敵人；保留第四組延遲出怪與最後頭目觸發。

entries.source: Consider starting from Temple of the Ages to get a party size of 8. Also, the path through the Black Curtain has fewer foes than the one through Nebo Terrace if you start from Bergen Hot Springs. With your party of 8, you can also consider caravan vanquishing by continuing with your party of 8 into Nebo Terrace and beyond.
entries.text: 可考慮從世紀神殿出發，組成 8 人隊伍。若從卑爾根溫泉出發，經黑幕的路線比經尼伯山丘的路線敵人更少。有了 8 人隊伍後，也可考慮連續清剿：帶著這支 8 人隊伍繼續進入尼伯山丘及後續區域。
entries.reason: caravan vanquishing 指維持較大隊伍連續清剿，並非征服商隊；三處 8 保留。

entries.source: Finish off groups quickly. Your party will need to be deadly efficient and organized. The longer a group of titans takes to kill, the closer your party is to certain failure as it will soon be overrun.
entries.text: 迅速消滅每群敵人。隊伍必須配合有序、殺敵高效；消滅一群泰坦花的時間越久，就越接近失敗，因為隊伍很快便會被敵人淹沒。
entries.reason: 原文被殺的是泰坦，不是泰坦花時間殺玩家；finish groups 是消滅敵群，非完成小組任務。

entries.source: Upon accepting this quest two large groups of Abyssals and Shadow Beasts will spawn at the doors to the Temple, and will soon start attacking the altar. Make sure your party is ready before accepting.
entries.text: 接取此任務後，兩大群 Abyssals 與 Shadow Beasts 會出現在神殿門口，隨即開始攻擊祭壇。接取前，務必先讓隊伍做好準備。
entries.reason: 保留兩大群敵人及接取後即刷新的觸發順序，party 是隊伍。未證敵人中文定名保留英文。

entries.source: Due to how far this location is, consider vanquishing Snake Dance, Dreadnought's Drift and Lornar's Pass in one go. Leaving from Camp Rankor to accomplish this will also allow for a party size of 8, where an exit from Beacon's Perch restricts the party to 6 members.
entries.text: 此地距離遙遠，可考慮一次連續清剿蛇舞、無懼者之丘和洛拿斯通道。從藍口營地出發可帶 8 人隊伍；若從畢肯高地出發，隊伍人數上限則為 6 人。
entries.reason: leaving 是從據點出發，vanquishing 是清剿；保留 8 與 6 的隊伍人數差異。

entries.source: With great patience, it is possible to bring a party of 8 from the Temple of the Ages.
entries.text: 只要有足夠耐心，就能從世紀神殿帶一支 8 人隊伍過來。
entries.reason: 8 是隊員人數，非聚會規模或敵群數。

entries.source: Tapestry Shred (Prophecies characters only)
entries.text: Tapestry Shred（僅限《阿斯卡隆戰記》建立的角色）
entries.reason: 修正 character 為角色，保留物品英文身份與篇章限定。

entries.source: Also consider starting from Yak's Bend to benefit from a party size of 6.
entries.text: 也可考慮從犛牛村出發，以便組成 6 人隊伍。
entries.reason: 起點選擇影響隊伍人數上限，非聚會規模；保留 6。

entries.source: Switch districts (switch to International from your district, or vice-versa, if there is only one local district.) or return to the character selection screen and select the same character again (F12, c, space/enter).
entries.text: 切換分流（若當地只有一個分流，可從目前分流切至國際分流，或反向切換），或返回角色選擇畫面，再選取同一角色（F12、c、空白鍵／Enter）。
entries.reason: district 是分流，character selection 是角色選擇；保留同一角色與按鍵次序。

entries.source: Exit Olafstead and follow the first quest marker, located on a small island to the northwest. As the party approaches, Xandra's dialogue will begin and Tanto the Grim will appear with a mob of Regrets. You will have the environmental effect Haunted Ground on you and your party. Be wary of the Ice Imps that populate the island—consider pulling them away from the marker so you do not have to fight both groups at once.
entries.text: 離開尤拉夫之地，前往西北方小島上的第一個任務標記。隊伍接近時，珊卓亞會開始對話，Tanto the Grim 隨即帶著一群 Regrets 出現。你與隊伍都會受到環境效果 Haunted Ground 影響。小心島上的冰小鬼；可先將牠們引離任務標記，避免同時對付兩群敵人。
entries.reason: party 指隊伍；修復 Haunted Ground 半譯，保留接近觸發對話與敵人出現、分批引怪的順序。

entries.source: It is recommended to start from Camp Rankor and vanquish Snake Dance and Dreadnought's Drift along the way. While this takes a while, you have a party of 8, making it easier than starting from Beacon's Perch.
entries.text: 建議從藍口營地出發，沿途清剿蛇舞與無懼者之丘。雖然比較費時，但能帶 8 人隊伍，因此比從畢肯高地出發容易。
entries.reason: vanquish 是清剿地區，不是擊敗地名；保留八人隊伍與較長路線的取捨。

entries.source: Since you can only have a party of four, having a spirit spammer helps.
entries.text: 此處只能組成四人隊伍，因此帶一名能頻繁召喚精魂的角色會有幫助。
entries.reason: spirit spammer 是持續召喚精魂的配置，不是精神垃圾郵件傳送者。

entries.source: The Count's Daughter quest will lead characters through here. The first time characters enter here will be from Maatu Keep or Sunjiang District.
entries.text: 「伯爵的女兒」任務會引導角色經過此地。角色第一次進入此地時，會從麻都堡壘或孫江行政區抵達。
entries.reason: enter 是角色進入區域，非輸入字元；保留首次進入的兩個來源地點。

entries.source: After completing Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation, speak with Sokka to obtain an Asuran Beacon, which can be dropped to create a G.O.L.E.M. 1.0 to aid your party.
entries.text: 完成 Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation 後，與 Sokka 交談可取得 Asuran Beacon。將它放到地上，便會產生一具 G.O.L.E.M. 1.0 協助隊伍。
entries.reason: 專名保留完整英文，避免逐字譯出天才操作的生活等失真；dropped 是放下攜帶物後生成魔像。

entries.source: Furious Battle Axe of Charrslaying
entries.text: Furious Battle Axe of Charrslaying
entries.reason: 原文為完整裝備名稱，Charrslaying 不含文字字元概念。缺完整中文定名佐證時保留英文，避免猜成官方名稱。

entries.source: Starting from Blacktide Den or Beknur Harbor and arriving here via Cliffs of Dohjok will enable a party of 8 instead of 4.
entries.text: 從黑潮之穴或 Beknur Harbor 出發，經杜夏懸崖抵達此地，便可帶 8 人隊伍，而非 4 人。
entries.reason: 保留兩個可替代起點、經由區域及 8 而非 4 人的比較。

entries.source: Factions characters can vanquish this area by killing or charming a single animal. This trick requires that all characters have completed An Unwelcome Guest and that Winds of Change is not active (either because the character has not started it or because Memories of Purity is active). It will not work if the party includes any Prophecies or Nightfall characters. This is an intended feature, rewarding Canthan natives for their role in clearing evil from the area. (Source: Gaile Gray at Inc Gamers, in 2008 (Broken link))
entries.text: 《盟與敵》角色只需殺死或馴服一隻動物，就能清剿此區域。使用此方法時，所有角色都必須已完成 An Unwelcome Guest，而且「變幻之風」不得啟用（角色尚未開始該系列，或已啟用 Memories of Purity）。若隊伍中有任何《阿斯卡隆戰記》或《黑暗逆襲》角色，此方法就無效。這是刻意設計的機制，用來獎勵凱珊本地角色清除此區邪惡的貢獻。（來源：Gaile Gray，Inc Gamers，2008 年；連結已失效。）
entries.reason: charming 是馴服而非迷惑，vanquish 是清剿；保留所有角色、任何外地角色即無效及兩種未啟用變幻之風的條件。

entries.source:
To start the mission, Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Into Chahbek Village or Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial). However, they can be ferried into the mission by another character, and will receive full credit for mission completion.
Characters from other campaigns should talk to Historian Laharo, in the southeast corner of Churrhir Fields.
Koss must be present in the party.
entries.text:
要開始此主線任務，《黑暗逆襲》角色必須已領取 Into Chahbek Village 或 Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial) 的獎勵。不過，也能由另一名角色帶入任務，並取得完整的任務完成認定。
其他篇章的角色應與丘裡爾平原東南角的 Historian Laharo 交談。
寇斯必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: full credit 是完整完成認定而非積分獎勵；保留領獎要求、帶入例外及指定英雄。未證完整任務名保留英文。

entries.source:
All Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Signs and Portents.
Melonni must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有《黑暗逆襲》角色都必須已領取 Signs and Portents 的獎勵。
梅隆妮必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留所有該篇章角色、已領獎而非僅完成，以及英雄入隊三項條件。

entries.source:
All Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Following the Trail.
Tahlkora must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有《黑暗逆襲》角色都必須已領取 Following the Trail 的獎勵。
塔爾科拉必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留篇章範圍與已領獎要求，party 是隊伍而非聚會。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for The Time is Nigh.
Dunkoro must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 The Time is Nigh 的獎勵。
Dunkoro 必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: party members 是隊員而非黨員，完成與領取獎勵不可混同。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for And a Hero Shall Lead Them.
Koss must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 And a Hero Shall Lead Them 的獎勵。
寇斯必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: And a Hero Shall Lead Them 是單一任務名，不是指示由英雄領導隊伍；保留已領獎限制。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for No Me, No Kormir or To Kill a Demon.
Margrid the Sly must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 No Me, No Kormir 或 To Kill a Demon 的獎勵。
狡猾的瑪格麗德必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: No Me, No Kormir 為含逗號的單一任務名稱，舊譯錯拆成兩個任務；兩個可替代任務以或連接。

entries.source:
Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Prophet's Path or Skyward Reach and talk to Great Ritual Priest Zahmut to start the mission. Completing Dunes of Despair, Thirsty River, or Elona Reach also brings the party here.
Although it is possible to enter the mission without completing Dunes of Despair, Thirsty River, or Elona Reach, you do need to complete these to activate the ascension glyphs, which is necessary to complete Augury Rock.
entries.text:
任何角色都能從先知之路或天際流域步行進入此據點，與儀式大祭司撒穆特交談，開始主線任務。完成「絕望沙丘」、「乾枯河流」或「伊洛那流域」也會把隊伍帶到這裡。
雖然不必先完成這三個主線任務就能進場，但要啟動昇華符文，仍須完成這三個任務；這是完成「占卜之石」所必需的。
entries.reason: 區分可進場與能完成兩件事；三個任務對符文啟動均必要，不將第一句或誤套為只需完成其一。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for To Kill a Demon or No Me, No Kormir.
Master of Whispers must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 To Kill a Demon 或 No Me, No Kormir 的獎勵。
密語大師必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留兩個任務名與或的替代關係，No Me, No Kormir 不拆分；英雄需入隊。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for Greed and Regret or Calling the Order.
Margrid the Sly must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 Greed and Regret 或 Calling the Order 的獎勵。
狡猾的瑪格麗德必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 黨員改為隊員；保留兩個任務的替代關係與已領獎要求。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for Calling the Order or Greed and Regret.
Master of Whispers must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 Calling the Order 或 Greed and Regret 的獎勵。
密語大師必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留原文兩個任務順序、或與指定英雄；party 不是政黨。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for Pledge of the Merchant Princes.
Tahlkora must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 Pledge of the Merchant Princes 的獎勵。
塔爾科拉必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: Pledge of the Merchant Princes 是任務名，不能被誤譯為雜貨商人的誓言；保留已領獎條件。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger.
Koss must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger 的獎勵。
寇斯必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留 Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger 的完整單一任務身份，未證中文定名不猜譯。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger.
Melonni must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger 的獎勵。
梅隆妮必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留 Ronjok 分支的完整任務身份，與 Garden 分支不混同；指定英雄不同。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for Horde of Darkness.
General Morgahn must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 Horde of Darkness 的獎勵。
摩根將軍必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: 保留完整任務英文身份與已領獎限定；指定英雄必須入隊。

entries.source:
All party members must have accepted the reward for Uncharted Territory.
Dunkoro must be present in the party.
entries.text:
所有隊員都必須已領取 Uncharted Territory 的獎勵。
Dunkoro 必須在隊伍中。
entries.reason: Uncharted Territory 是本遊戲任務，舊譯神秘海域容易與其他遊戲名稱混同；未證定名保留英文。

entries.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed To Tahnnakai Temple (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Shenzun Tunnels will be closed.
To Tahnnakai Temple grants access, but any characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter will be left behind in Shenzun Tunnels.
entries.text:
開始此主線任務本身沒有前置要求；但若隊伍中有任何尚未完成「前往譚納凱神殿」的角色（不必領取獎勵），申贊通道的大門便會關閉。
完成「前往譚納凱神殿」可開放通行，但任何尚未完成「納普區」的角色都會被留在申贊通道。
entries.reason: 分清任務入場、開門任務完成與通過者資格；不必領獎的例外僅限原文指定任務。

entries.source:
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
Completed the Augury Rock mission
Must have changed secondary profession at least once to another profession (see Notes), either
via a profession changer and a manual change via the Skills and Attributes Panel to first the original secondary profession and then the newly acquired one again, or
by completing one of the following "'s Path" quests:
The Elementalist's Path
The Mesmer's Path
The Monk's Path
The Necromancer's Path
The Ranger's Path
The Warrior's Path
entries.text:
在《阿斯卡隆戰記》中建立的角色。
已完成「占卜之石」主線任務。
必須曾至少一次把副職業改成其他職業（見注意事項），可採以下任一方式：
向職業變更者解鎖新副職業後，在技能與屬性面板手動切回原副職業，再切回新解鎖的副職業；或
完成以下任一個「職業之路」任務：
The Elementalist's Path
The Mesmer's Path
The Monk's Path
The Necromancer's Path
The Ranger's Path
The Warrior's Path
entries.reason: 明確至少一次變更副職業及兩種替代方法；保留面板先切原副職再切新副職的必要順序與六個原任務身份。
